item.text: Hello, I’m glad to hear about the neighborhood cleanup and would be happy to help with sorting and organizing supplies before the event begins. I can assist with separating gloves, bags, recycling materials, sign-in items, and any other equipment that needs to be prepared or distributed. Unfortunately, I won’t be able to stay for the entire cleanup because I have another commitment later that day. Please let me know what time you would like volunteers to arrive for setup and how long the supply-sorting work is likely to take. I’d still like to contribute as much as I can during the time I’m available, and I appreciate all the effort you’re putting into organizing this event.
